notes.title: Update #1
notes.content:
We're very happy to announce the first steam update for Ichi. Thanks to your feedback we've added some great new features.

- Partial controller support
- Big Picture Mode
- Hold SHIFT (windows) or OPTION (mac) at start up to choose resolution.
- Minor bug fixes
- Now with more than 20,000 levels!
